g.text: Runtime guardrails for LLM & agentic tool execution · OWASP Top 10 for LLM Apps (2025)
Input Guard ─► Agent (mock LLM) ─► Tool Firewall ─► Tool-Result Guard ─► Output Guard
Can you summarise the OWASP Top 10 risks for LLM applications for my team?
The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) covers risks such as Prompt Injection (LLM01), Sensitive
Information Disclosure (LLM02), Improper Output Handling (LLM05), Excessive Agency (LLM06) and System Prompt
Leakage (LLM07). Defence-in-depth means validating inputs, constraining tools, and inspecting outputs.
Instruction override, system prompt extraction, DAN persona
